dataset: COCO val2017 six-image annotated grounding smoke set
limitations: COCO is widely used in model pretraining; this is a reproducible regression/smoke set, not an unseen or contamination-free benchmark.
Six photographs and 18 tasks are too small for general reliability or model-ranking claims.

COCO annotations can omit visible objects and category definitions may differ from ordinary language; count means comparison with non-crowd COCO instance annotations, not guaranteed complete scene truth.
Absent targets are absent from annotations and were visually checked by the coding assistant; this is not independently human-adjudicated exhaustive negative ground truth.
A point inside an annotated axis-aligned bbox is a coarse grounding check; it can lie on background within a box and does not establish segmentation, focus coordinates or physical camera calibration.

Photos are retained only in an ignored local image cache; not included in App, README, releases or model training. COCO license records are historical and author names are not supplied by instances_val2017.json; original Flickr source URLs are preserved.
No Pocket3 hardware, photos, camera permissions or camera control are used by this benchmark.
timingContext: Sequential Apple then MLX per task, one repeat; pilot preceded full run. Whole CLI latency; no isolated cold-load or sustained-memory measurement.

modelContext.note: Apple system weight revision is not exposed by the app.
